1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 Nf6 4.e5.strategy: Drives the knight away and takes space, committing White to a pawn on e5 that Black will attack. If White's pieces can support it, the cramp on Black's kingside is a real asset; if not, the pawn is overextended.

1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 Nf6 4.e5 Nd5.strategy: Centralises the knight, which has no better square, and eyes c3. The knight stands well here, and White's c3, played earlier, takes away the natural square of the b1-knight and so helps Black.
